title: Borrow $400K for a House, Pay Back Almost $1M 🏠 #shorts
description:
At this week's average 30-year mortgage rate of 7.28%, a $400,000 loan costs about $2,737 a month, and about $585,000 in interest over 30 years (loan payment only, not taxes or insurance). A 15-year loan at the same rate: about $258,000 in interest.
Source: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey (Nov 19, 2026); The Mortgage Reports (Nov 2026); payments calculated with the standard amortization formula. Education, not financial advice.
script: Borrow four hundred thousand dollars for a house, and you'll pay back almost a million.
This week, Freddie Mac says the average thirty-year mortgage rate is seven point two eight percent.
That's a payment of about two thousand seven hundred dollars, every month, for thirty years.
The interest alone adds up to about five hundred eighty-five thousand dollars. More than the house.
And in year one, under four thousand dollars of your payments actually pays down the loan.
Same loan over fifteen years? The interest drops to about two hundred fifty-eight thousand.
So before you sign, don't just ask about the monthly payment. Ask about the total.
